requirements.title: Pointers associated with a TARGET-less allocatable actual do not become associated with a TARGET-less dummy
requirements.definition: For an allocatable dummy argument without TARGET, pointers associated with the actual argument do not become associated with the corresponding dummy argument on procedure invocation.

Future fixtures may test the TARGET case instead.

requirements.title: Forwarded TARGET association through a TARGET-less allocatable dummy is processor dependent
requirements.definition: For an allocatable dummy without TARGET used as an actual argument associated with a TARGET dummy, association of pointers to the original actual with the TARGET dummy is processor dependent.
